name: gizza-ai/ja3-fingerprint
summary: Compute the JA3 TLS client fingerprint from a ClientHello

tool.description: Compute the JA3 (and normalized JA3N) TLS client fingerprint string and MD5 hash from a raw ClientHello given as a hex string (SSLVersion,Ciphers,Extensions,EllipticCurves,EllipticCurvePointFormats with GREASE removed).
